mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls growth above 0.3 percentage points signals stronger household income and consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the condition is met (t-test p > 0.05) or fewer than 40% of triggered instances are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index by more than 5% signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drags S&P 500 returns lower over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the condition is met (t-test p > 0.05) or fewer than 40% of triggered instances are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below zero signals deteriorating manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the condition is met (t-test p > 0.05) or fewer than 40% of triggered instances are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in the Consumer Price Index above 0.4% signals rising inflation, which prompts tighter monetary policy and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the condition is met (t-test p > 0.05) or fewer than 40% of triggered instances are negative.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the condition is met (t-test p > 0.05) or fewer than 40% of triggered instances are negative.
